baseline_note: New repository; no baseline commit existed before the initial implementation.
coverage: local-data privacy and CI supply-chain controls

findings.finding: GenAI span conventions remain in development, including invoke_agent and execute_tool; separate the mapping from the rest of the product.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Future attribute changes require compatibility review
findings.engineering_cost: Small initial mapping; continuing compatibility tests
findings.roadmap_delta: Use native SDK spans and isolate metadata fields
findings.verification_needed: Versioned external fixtures and future schema migration tests

findings.finding: OTLP JSON uses hexadecimal trace/span IDs and integer enums. The SDK protobuf encoder can supply the trace structure.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Generic protobuf JSON uses base64 IDs, so conversion must be tested
findings.engineering_cost: Small exporter plus schema decode tests
findings.roadmap_delta: Persist OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest documents as JSON lines
findings.verification_needed: Decode emitted messages with the official schema; broader external collector interoperability remains future work

findings.finding: The name Spanforge is already used by public tracing projects. The maintainer selected a distinct project name; CausalSpan had no exact repository-name search results during setup.
findings.direction_alignment: Retains the concept with a distinct name
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Search is not a guarantee of name availability in every registry
findings.verification_needed: Recheck package registry availability before a package release

findings.finding: Langfuse exposes OpenTelemetry ingestion and SDKs; a small offline debugging workflow should have a narrower scope than a hosted observability platform.
findings.direction_alignment: Emphasize local inspection and mocked tool replay
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Broad provider/framework coverage would expand maintenance substantially
findings.verification_needed: User feedback on local workflow and compatibility fixtures

findings.finding: MCP and A2A have protocol-specific message and lifecycle semantics that need dedicated propagation tests.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Manual tool wrapping must not be advertised as native protocol integration
findings.verification_needed: Current protocol tracing specifications and conformance fixtures

overall_recommendation: Build one local Python tracing/comparison/replay slice with explicit instrumentation, opt-in payloads, offline tests, and no hosted services. Keep research advisory; the implementation scope follows the maintainer's project-creation request.
evidence_gaps: No live provider or distributed protocol test
No claim of trademark or universal package-name clearance
Tool-payload key redaction cannot guarantee confidentiality
External OTLP compatibility matrix remains proposed work
next_review_trigger: Semantic-convention or OpenTelemetry dependency changes; review before protocol adapters or a package release.
